summary: The PR addresses the issue of unnecessary joins in the admin changelist query by combining all search terms into a single Q object. However, there are some minor style and potential behavioral concerns.

issues.description: The newlines at the end of files (testapp/admin.py and testapp/models.py) should be removed to match the project's style.

The change could potentially alter the behavior of the search functionality, especially if the original behavior was intended to handle multiple search terms separately. This needs further verification to ensure no unintended side effects.
